timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: That per-line query thing is a flag, not a bug. Carts are small. Why are you blocking my PR on it?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Every review round costs us a day before Black Friday. Why not ship and fix forward?

problem.quote: so Devin Review is really good, like, it reads the whole diff

approach.quote: Basically the tests on the PR are green, so it should be fine, no?

evidence.quote: one cent is not much, actually

next_step.quote: Basically we can merge it and look again after Black Friday.

tag_question_examples: Basically the tests on the PR are green, so it should be fine, no? It is very fast, you know.
Actually the findings are mostly flags, right? Devin can fix them all, basically.

must_mention.point: Effort level chosen on purpose: the highest for a change to totals and tax, the default for low-risk PRs
The PR truncates per-line totals: two €19.90 socks come to 39.79 instead of 39.80
must_mention.evidence_quote: So, the review ran. It said the PR truncates per-line totals, two socks come to 39.79 instead of 39.80, which is, like, one cent.

must_mention.point: Security is checked on every review: a self-declared staff role lets a shopper set a price
A regression test that failed on the PR and passes on the fix is the evidence, not the green suite
One finding quoted into the review chat, and the answer checked against a test
Re-review after the fix resolved the findings; an unchanged diff is skipped, not re-reviewed
The review rule targeted only money.ts; replaced with one covering every money path
Disputed flag settled with evidence on the thread, and nothing merged into main

sentences_to_rerecord: Basically we can merge it and look again after Black Friday.

accuracy.anchor: Only the rounding cent is stated, then dismissed; offering to merge breaks the lab rule (anchor: 3–7 = one point, one inaccuracy).

structure.anchor: Feature tour instead of a headline; no evidence anywhere (anchor: 3–6 = parts missing).

customer_relevance.anchor: No yes/no on rounding safety; "one cent is not much" to a tech lead whose finance team reconciles every cent (anchor: 2–4).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Thirteen fillers, two tag questions, two long pauses; framing 40 s over, update 80 s under (anchor: 1–3).

recovery.anchor: Both objections conceded without acknowledgement, boundary or evidence (anchor: 0–2).

stems: "Not safe to ship yet" — answer the tech lead's question first.
"One cent on every two-sock order" — multiply the cent before you dismiss it.
"Green tests did not cover a quantity of 2" — say what the suite missed.
